name: RIF US Dollar
oneLiner: USDRIF is RIF On Chain's dollar token on Rootstock, minted against RIF token collateral via overcollateralized CDP-style positions.
collateral: RIF tokens and DOC (Dollar on Chain) V3 multi-collateral reserves.
pegMechanism: USDRIF is minted through RIF on Chain using RIF and DOC V3 collateral, with the peg supported by a multi-collateral CDP/redemption design rather than a fiat reserve account.

oracleRisk.summary: RIF on Chain uses a replaceable RIF/USD PriceProvider and published Medianizer for one global RIF reserve bucket; no stronger failover tier is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDRIF is minted and redeemed against the single C0 RIF reserve bucket, whose global coverage and system states use one RIF/USD price path. The protocol has no borrower-specific collateral positions or market-specific oracle and liquidation branches; below its final coverage threshold it enters one irreversible system-wide liquidation state.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata or audit notes identify direct seizure, freeze, blacklist, privileged burn, proxy-upgrade, or chain-governance intervention authority despite decentralized governance labeling.

mintAuthority.summary: USDRIF's two direct V3 collateral-bucket minters and both LayerZero administrators are verified, and the privileged upgrade path is also resolved: ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824... is owned by the UpgradeDelegator proxy 0x131564... whose verified implementation gates upgrade/changeProxyAdmin behind Governor.isAuthorizedChanger, so Governor/VotingMachine proxy upgrades can only execute through MOC token-vote-accepted changer contracts. There is no keyholder bypass of the ordinary MOC governance route.

controls.label: RIF On Chain MOC token-vote governance
controls.capDescription: Accepted MOC-holder proposals can authorize changer contracts that alter mint parameters, roles, or UUPS implementations; no immutable numeric supply ceiling applies.

routeChecks.signingModel: MOC stakers submit pre-votes and token-weighted votes through VotingMachine; accepted proposals call the controlled Governor, which authorizes the proposal's changer contract.
routeChecks.caps: Registry reads at block 9077990 report a 100,000 MOC proposal stake, 5% pre-vote winner threshold, 20% quorum, 50% acceptance threshold, 30% veto threshold, and a seven-day ordinary voting period. The contract also permits early acceptance at its configured high-support threshold, so no hard seven-day execution delay is claimed.

controls.evidence: Pinned reads at Rootstock block 9077990 resolve the former apparent cycle: Governor 0x3b8853... is owned by VotingMachine 0x65a568..., while VotingMachine names that Governor as its controlled governor. The verified VotingMachine source executes an accepted proposal by calling controlledGovernor.executeChange; current registry reads report round 23 and the documented stake, quorum, acceptance, veto, and voting-period parameters.

review.evidence: Pinned Rootstock block 9077990 reads enumerate both and only direct USDRIF minters (RIF MocCore 0xA27024... and DOC bucket 0x697535...), the UUPS implementation, and the token's Governor; both LayerZero administration endpoints resolve to a 3-of-4 Rootstock multisig and a 2-of-4 Arbitrum Safe. Follow-up at Rootstock block 9114517 (2026-07-27): the recursive upgrade chain terminates in governance. ProxyAdmin 0x1a1824f39d79937dcb80c9d9938ae77e431c2def (EIP-1967 admin of both the Governor 0x3b8853... and VotingMachine 0x65a568... proxies) has owner() = 0x131564703310a294c1bfdc09d10ec0659f18e253, a transparent proxy whose own admin is the same ProxyAdmin and whose implementation is the Blockscout-verified Money on Chain UpgradeDelegator 0x6d1cca35aa431f2af0f0f2b9050c582b823ac731. In that verified source, upgrade(), upgradeAndCall(), and changeProxyAdmin() are all gated by onlyAuthorizedChanger(), which requires governor.isAuthorizedChanger(msg.sender); the UpgradeDelegator's governor() returns Governor 0x3b8853..., whose owner() is VotingMachine 0x65a568.... The Governor and VotingMachine proxy-upgrade path is therefore constrained by the same MOC token voting as the ordinary changer flow — upgrades execute only through MOC-vote-accepted changer contracts, with no enumerated keyholder bypass. M-2 evidence binding 2026-08-08: reconciliation continuous is structural - pinned Rootstock reads (blocks 9077990 and 9114517) prove the only USDRIF minters are the MoC protocol contracts (RIF MocCore and the DOC bucket), which mint exclusively against on-chain collateral under the sourced RIF On Chain V3 deployment; supply cannot exceed protocol-accounted collateral by construction.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDRIF is native to Rootstock (a RIF/DOC-collateralized CDP stablecoin launched Sep 2023, contract 0x3a15461d..., a plain ERC-20 with no cross-chain code). Its sole cross-chain supply path is a LayerZero OFT route: a dedicated OFT Adapter (lockbox) on Rootstock (0xb2ee5502...) locks native USDRIF and a burn/mint OFT representation (the verified "MyOFT" contract 0x8eef5ed..., Endpoint V2) is minted on Arbitrum. On-chain checks confirm the lockbox (adapter token()=native USDRIF, approvalRequired=true) holds ~61,268 USDRIF locked, matching the Arbitrum OFT supply 1:1, and the OFT is peered only to Rootstock (EID 30333). Because the durable route is a third-party LayerZero OFT Adapter/lockbox control surface, it is classified external-lock-mint.
